name: The Swarm Grows
summary: At Ironstone Camp, Moktar Krin says Belgrom wants the silithid driven back underground. His war party is too weakened to fight, so you are sent to the dig site south of camp to face them.

sections.title: A Half-Dead War Party
sections.body:
Moktar Krin says Belgrom considers the silithid a threat and wants them driven back into the depths they came from. Moktar's war party has already killed the dwarves sent by the Explorers' League, but the fighters are in no state for another battle.

The dig site lies south of Ironstone Camp, and Moktar expects no more dwarves there. You are to kill the silithid Searchers, hive drones and invaders. Moktar's party cannot leave until the work is done.

sections.title: Moktar's Thanks
sections.body: Moktar jokes that the ichor covering you improves your looks, though you reek of it. He warns you to keep away from the kodo. The smell alone proves you have done your part against the silithid.

faq.q: Where is the silithid infestation located?
faq.answer: The infestation is at the Rustmaul Dig Site, south of Ironstone Camp.

faq.q: Why can't Moktar Krin's party handle the insects themselves?
aliases: why is the war party hurt
faq.answer: Moktar's war party is half-dead after killing the dwarves sent by the Explorers' League, and cannot fight another battle in that condition.

faq.q: Who wants the silithid driven back?
faq.answer: Belgrom, who sees the silithid as a threat and wants them pushed back into the depths they came from.

faq.q: What kinds of silithid must be defeated?
faq.answer: You must defeat Silithid Searchers, Silithid Hive Drones and Silithid Invaders, five of each.

faq.q: Are there still dwarves at the dig site?
faq.answer: Moktar expects no more dwarves at the dig site.
